caption: The drawing depicts a single old-fashioned ice skate with a wooden base and a metal blade. The wooden part of the skate is rectangular and has a rough texture with a weathered appearance, featuring natural wood grain and areas painted in a faded red color. There are two leather straps, one near the front and one near the back, attached to the wooden base for securing the skate to a shoe or boot; both straps are brown and show signs of wear. The underside of the skate has a long, slightly curved and rusted metal blade which extends past the front of the wooden base, curving upwards into a pronounced hook shape. The background is a plain, light beige color, and there is a small, centered handwritten label beneath the skate reading "Eugene Baatz."
title: Ice Skate
